summary: Suncor Energy filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent disclosure for a Canadian foreign private issuer) containing a news release dated October 20, 2026, announcing the timing of its third-quarter 2026 results. Results are scheduled for release November 3, 2026 before 6:00 p.m. ABT, with a webcast and analyst Q&A on November 4, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ABT, archived for 90 days. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
